articles.summary: ORLANDO, FL / May 28, 2026 / Laser Photonics Corporation (NASDAQ:LASE) ("Laser Photonics" or the "Company"), a global leader in laser systems for industrial and defense applications, today announced that its subsidiary, CMS Laser, has received a $250K order from Johnson & Johnson for a custom on-the-fly (OTF) laser drilling system with integrated vision. articles.title: Laser Photonics Expands into Precision Medical Device Manufacturing with Custom Laser Drilling System Order from Johnson & Johnson
